detail.name: Evelyn's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Evelyn's Mindscape: Metamorphosis
detail.desc2:
A business card featuring the image of a not-too-famous security consultant.
For those ready to spend a small fortune on security, this clean and straightforward card symbolizes a second chance at life. Unfortunately, the well-reputed "Life Protection Service" is currently unavailable for purchase.
